source: Owner's visual calibration cross-checked against maid.cdi3.json IDs; ranges and directions below are visual observations, not a dump of Core min/max.

usage.target: Future AI/JEV motion planner and Android parameter mixer
usage.timing: All values are continuous targets; interpolate to and from each target unless the entry explicitly says discrete.
usage.ownership: Keep breathing, autonomous blink, subtle gaze and idle motion local. AI/JEV requests short-lived expressive targets; explicit preset actions and speech lip-sync own their channels while active.
usage.validation: Whitelist actual maid CDI/Core parameter IDs, clamp to the model's runtime min/max, and restore neutral or the lower-priority layer when a timed request ends. Never send these maid IDs to the Sen accessory donor.
usage.priority: Explicit preset or manual test > speaking/reaction parameter plan > local idle; preserve audio lip-sync ownership of mouth opening and autonomous blink ownership of unrequested eye-open values.
usage.captureAxisCaution: ParamAngleX and ParamAngleY are named capture axes; current Android full head sweep uses ParamAngleX3 and ParamAngleY2 for visible motion. Confirm the intended rig target before promoting capture axes to AI output.

parameters.label: 呼吸
parameters.motion: 0→1→0 is one full breath; loop smoothly, never latch at an endpoint.
parameters.currentAndroid: The local performance clock writes a sine breath each frame (currently approximately 0.08–0.92), including the Sen donor tail physics input. Do not schedule an extra AI breath.

parameters.label: 嘴变形
parameters.motion: Blend for expression; return to the prior expression when the timed reaction ends.

parameters.label: 嘴张开和闭合
parameters.motion: Continuous opening; while TTS is playing, lip-sync owns this parameter.

parameters.label: 歪嘴
parameters.motion: Blend through center for a fleeting asymmetric mouth shape.
parameters.caution: This is uppercase MOUTHX in the maid CDI; ParamMouthX is a different name used in Sen code.

parameters.label: 吐舌头
parameters.motion: Treat as discrete: animate quickly to 1, hold briefly, then return to 0; intermediate values are not visually useful.

parameters.label: 闭嘴撅嘴
parameters.motion: Blend for a brief pout; avoid competing with strong speech opening.

parameters.label: 嘴宽／脸圆感
parameters.atMax: 脸部显得更圆（用户视觉观察，待真机确认）
parameters.motion: Do not put into idle or AI control until the PUCKER=1 test is evaluated.
parameters.currentAndroid: Manual PUCKER=1 preview button; off restores the active model or expression value.

parameters.label: 角度 Z-捕
parameters.motion: Smooth side tilt; modest idle excursions, larger only for explicit reaction.
parameters.currentAndroid: The full Z sweep also writes ParamAngleZ2.

parameters.label: 角度 X-捕
parameters.motion: Smooth yaw.
parameters.currentAndroid: Existing full visible X sweep writes ParamAngleX3; ParamAngleX alone barely moves the rendered head in this rig.

parameters.label: 角度 Y-捕
parameters.motion: Smooth pitch.
parameters.currentAndroid: Existing full visible Y sweep writes ParamAngleY2; validate before AI uses ParamAngleY alone.

parameters.label: 身体旋转 X
parameters.atMin: 身体与双胯向一侧运动
parameters.atMax: 身体与双胯向另一侧运动
parameters.motion: Transient movement; the authored motion returns automatically. Do not force a held pose or change its return behavior.

parameters.label: 身体旋转 Y
parameters.motion: Use small smooth rise and fall if later added to idle; this is the visible vertical body bounce source, not ParamBodyPositiony.

parameters.label: 身体旋转 Z
parameters.motion: Smooth body sway.

parameters.label: 眼珠 X
parameters.motion: Smooth gaze; local idle owns it unless an explicit attention or reaction target is active.

parameters.label: 眼珠 Y
parameters.motion: Smooth gaze; local idle owns it unless an explicit attention or reaction target is active.

parameters.label: 左眼开闭
parameters.motion: Short left-only wink may target 0 and restore 1; autonomous blink otherwise owns both eye-open channels.

parameters.label: 右眼开闭
parameters.motion: Short right-only wink may target 0 and restore 1; autonomous blink otherwise owns both eye-open channels.

parameters.label: 左眼微笑
parameters.motion: Coupled with ParamEyeLOpen: closing the left eye at 1 creates a smiling wink.

parameters.label: 右眼微笑
parameters.motion: Coupled with ParamEyeROpen: closing the right eye at 1 creates a smiling wink.

parameters.label: 左眉上下
parameters.motion: The brow drives the eye region too; use with eye-open/smile rather than treating it as an isolated brow translation.

parameters.label: 右眉上下
parameters.motion: The brow drives the eye region too; use with eye-open/smile rather than treating it as an isolated brow translation.

compositions.name: playful_left_wink
compositions.note: One-eye wink plus smiling eye corner; peace pose and short tongue make it more playful. Restore the eye-open channel after the wink.

compositions.name: playful_right_wink
compositions.note: Mirror recipe; do not assume the two eye parameters are interchangeable on screen.
